criteria.reference: Original family loaders, selectors, and renderers; full source image dictionaries remain available to the independent reference.
criteria.actual: Production loadShortHairStudioAssets and renderShortHairStudio, with only nine full neutral source images retained after compilation.
criteria.comparison: Exact RGBA equality at native face and full image sizes. No tolerance, transforms, camera access, or runtime monkey-patching.
criteria.coverage: 33 coefficient scenarios in face/full mode; original mode repeats neutral, independent gaze, and combined expressions in both framings.
criteria.limit: Equivalence verifies adapter dispatch and retained layers. It does not establish artistic quality or validate live camera hardware.
